title: Mailbox/set: role uniqueness not enforced across updates within same request
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set: all_mailboxes is fetched once before the update loop (line 339). Role uniqueness for update is checked against all_mailboxes (line 464) but NOT against other mailboxes being updated in the same request. Two update entries both setting role=inbox would both succeed, leaving two mailboxes with the same role.
